name: bagre
title: Bagre Threat Intelligence
description: Queries Bagre threat-intelligence sources for compromised credentials tied to a target domain. Default source is Intelligence X (intelx.io) — set INTELX_API_KEY as an agent env var; ClickHouse is an optional backend (BAGRE_SOURCE=clickhouse with CLICKHOUSE_* creds). Per-scan, set TARGET_DOMAIN (e.g. 'faradaysec') and optionally narrow with TARGET_SUBDOMAIN (LIKE wildcards), MAIL_DOMAIN, or URI_PATH. Emits one Faraday host per affected IP with the leaked credential as a vulnerability + linked credential record.
